<h1>Fáilte</h1>

<p>The Session is a community website dedicated to Irish traditional music.</p>
<p>You can <a href="/tunes">find tunes</a> to play, <a href="/sessions">find sessions</a> to play them in, and <a href="/discussions">join in discussions</a> about the music. You can also <a href="/events">find events</a> (like concerts and festivals), or <a href="/recordings">explore the track listings of recordings</a>.</p>
<p>You can contribute too. If you’re already a member, you can <a href="/login">log in</a>. If you’re not yet a member, membership is free and it only takes a moment to <a href="/signup">sign up</a>.</p>
<p>
<a href="/activity" rel="next">Recent Activity…</a>
</p>

(function (win, doc) {
    'use strict';
    if (!doc.querySelector || !win.HTMLDataListElement || !win.addEventListener) {
        return;
    }
    var ajax,
        searching,
        list,
        formfield = doc.querySelector('[role="search"] input[type="search"]'),
        suggestions = formfield.dataset.suggestions,
        autosuggest = function (query) {
            if (!win.Ajaxloader) {
                return;
            }
            if (!formfield.hasAttribute('list')) {
                return;
            }
            list = doc.getElementById(formfield.getAttribute('list'));
            query = query.toLowerCase();
            if (query.indexOf('the ') === 0) {
                query = query.split('the ')[1];
            }
            if (query.length > 3) {
                win.clearTimeout(searching);
                searching = win.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!ajax) {
                        ajax = new win.Ajaxloader();
                    }
                    ajax.setTarget(list);
                    ajax.setData('q=' + query);
                    ajax.load(suggestions);
                }, 250);
